lines.zh: 肩上扛着刀，我沿着土路走。
lines.en: I walk the dirt road with my blade on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我这身架子，比门框还高。
lines.en: This frame of mine stands taller than a doorway.

lines.zh: 草丛里有人影，我放慢脚步。
lines.en: A shape in the grass; I slow my pace.

lines.zh: 丛林里闷得很，我把头巾扯低。
lines.en: The jungle is stifling; I tug my bandana low.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I step on the leaves, trying to stay quiet.

lines.zh: 一路走过去，鸟都不叫了。
lines.en: As I pass, the birds go silent.
I swing the hilt loosely as I go.

lines.zh: 热带草原的草擦过我腰。
lines.en: Savanna grass brushes my waist.

lines.zh: 我拐进小路，那里更好下手。
lines.en: I cut onto a side trail; better spot for a job.

lines.zh: 我的靴底很硬，踩石子不疼。
lines.en: My soles are hard; stones don't bother me.

lines.zh: 我绕开村子，先看有几户人家。
lines.en: I circle the village and count the houses first.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边掂手里的袋子。
lines.en: I walk while weighing the bag in my hand.

lines.zh: 我靠在树边，把刀横在膝上。
lines.en: I lean on a tree with the blade across my knees.

lines.zh: 风里有炊烟，我在等天黑。
lines.en: There's cookfire smoke in the wind; I wait for dark.
I rewrap my bandana tighter.
A few strips of dried meat are left in my pocket.
I count the travelers on the road.

lines.zh: 树影动了一下，我只抬了抬眼。
lines.en: A shadow shifts; I only lift my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把指关节按得咔咔响。
lines.en: I crack my knuckles one by one.
Too open here; I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我用刀尖在土上划了道线。
lines.en: I draw a line in the dirt with my blade tip.

lines.zh: 远处有牛叫，我记下了位置。
lines.en: Cattle low in the distance; I note the spot.

lines.zh: 我在想，今晚该抢哪条路。
lines.en: I'm deciding which road to rob tonight.
I scrape the mud off my boot.
My heart beats steady, not a bit hurried.

lines.zh: 我把刀刃翻过来对光看。
lines.en: I turn the blade to the light.
This rock makes a fine seat.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树冠，估了一下高度。
lines.en: I glance up at the canopy and guess its height.
Someone passed by; I didn't move.

lines.zh: 我把腰带上的绳子理了理。
lines.en: I straighten the rope at my belt.

lines.zh: 站住，把身上的东西都放下。
lines.en: Stop right there and put everything down.
That outfit of yours is worth something.
I stand a head and a half above you.

lines.zh: 你一个人走这种路，胆子不小。
lines.en: Walking a road like this alone takes nerve.

lines.zh: 手上的东西，我劝你松手。
lines.en: I'd advise you to let go of what you're holding.

lines.zh: 别摸腰，我知道你想拿什么。
lines.en: Don't reach at your belt; I know what you want.
This road is mine. Where's the toll?

lines.zh: 你身上没有伴，那就好谈。
lines.en: You've no company, so we can talk.

lines.zh: 看你走路的样子，不像本地人。
lines.en: The way you walk, you're not from here.

lines.zh: 把头低一点，别看得我发毛。
lines.en: Keep your head down; that stare bothers me.

lines.zh: 我只取一半，留你一条命。
lines.en: I'll take half and leave you your life.
Nice boots. Take them off.

lines.zh: 肋骨挨了一下，我还能站。
lines.en: Got one in the ribs; I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我啐了一口，没什么大碍。
lines.en: I spit and shrug it off.
That cut isn't deep.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，把刀换了手。
lines.en: I step back and switch the blade to my other hand.
It hurts enough to shut one eye.
I've taken worse than that.
I grit my teeth and drop low.
Blood runs down the back of my hand.
I shudder once, then plant my feet.
Don't celebrate too soon.
Toss the bag over; don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我不缺肉，我缺值钱的东西。
lines.en: I've got meat enough; it's valuables I need.
You think that buys you the road?

lines.zh: 把手举起来，慢慢放下袋子。
lines.en: Hands up, and lower the bag slowly.
Your rations count too.
I can smell a coin purse from here.
Don't hand anything to me directly.
The more you cling to it, the more I want it.
Set it down, then back off ten paces.
That watch on your wrist looks fine.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一根柱子。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a post.
Not so close; my blade is long.
One shoulder and you stagger sideways.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我记住了。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; noted.
We squeeze through this door together.

lines.zh: 你被我的刀鞘绊了一下。
lines.en: My scabbard trips you up.

lines.zh: 站稳，我不喜欢人靠太近。
lines.en: Steady; I don't like people this near.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的包响了一声。
lines.en: That bump made your pack clink.
I step back half a pace to let you by.
Your arm brushes my coin purse.
In this trade, you last longer with a partner.

lines.zh: 我们分了地界，各走一边。
lines.en: We split the territory and take separate roads.
He keeps watch; I do the work.

lines.zh: 两个人蹲在树后数人头。
lines.en: Two of us crouch behind a tree, counting marks.
I don't ask where he came from.
We split the take and head back into the woods.
He has my back; I take the front.
We meet where the roads fork.

lines.zh: 他先走，我隔一会儿跟上。
lines.en: He goes first; I follow a while later.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，只是点头。
lines.en: Neither of us speaks; just a nod.
This bag is heavy; good quality.
Raw beef? That fetches coin too.
I pick up the dagger from the dirt.
That key you dropped might be useful.
I gather the scattered coppers.
That blade on the ground is mine.
I pick out the ones worth money.
I stoop fast.
I weigh it and tuck it inside my coat.
Even what's dropped in mud comes with me.

lines.zh: 你正好走进我守着的那段路。
lines.en: You've walked right into the stretch I hold.
I lower the blade from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 看清楚我的脸，记住就行。
lines.en: Get a good look at my face and remember it.
Few people about. Perfect.
I don't shout; I just step in.

lines.zh: 我把头巾拉上去遮住半张脸。
lines.en: I pull the bandana up over half my face.
Today there's a take.

lines.zh: 我把刀尖对着你的方向。
lines.en: I level the tip toward you.

lines.zh: 这条路上，没人会来救你。
lines.en: Nobody's coming to help on this road.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了一段，你没发现。
lines.en: I've trailed you a while; you never noticed.
You took the wrong fork.

lines.zh: 我算着你的脚程，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I pace your stride and close in.

lines.zh: 你停下来系鞋带，我也停下。
lines.en: You stop to tie a lace; I stop too.

lines.zh: 我绕到前面那棵大树后面。
lines.en: I circle behind the big tree ahead.
You look back, so I crouch.
I know every turn of this route.
I hide the blade behind my back.
Ten more steps and you're in the open.

lines.zh: 刀背砸在你肩上，你没喊出来。
lines.en: The flat of my blade hits your shoulder; no scream.

lines.zh: 我一脚踹开你手里的东西。
lines.en: One kick sends your weapon flying.
My tip splits your sleeve.
Up close is where the job gets done.

lines.zh: 我按着你的肩膀往下压。
lines.en: I press your shoulder down.
That leaves you short of breath.
I lay the blade across your throat.
You back off; I advance again.
I rob people in exactly this instant.
You're a bit lighter now, aren't you.

lines.zh: 我从草原的草丛里直起身。
lines.en: I rise out of the savanna grass.
There's one more of me on this road.
I duck my head to keep clear of the treetops.
I yawn and read the terrain first.
The woods are just quiet enough.
I walk out from the jungle's edge.
I look up; the sun is just past noon.
In this line of work, you find your way out first.
I'm here, and I brought a blade.

lines.zh: 村子那边，今晚会少点东西。
lines.en: That village will be missing a few things tonight.

lines.zh: 我在树上坐了一会儿才下来。
lines.en: I sit in a tree a while before climbing down.
I knot my bandana.

lines.zh: 火燎到裤腿，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my trouser leg; I swat at it.

lines.zh: 我从树上翻下来，脚踝一扭。
lines.en: I drop out of a tree and twist my ankle.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉管，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water pours down my throat; I kick upward.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡，怀里的钱袋掉了。
lines.en: The blast rings my ears and my coin bag falls.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的刀鞘上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my scabbard.

lines.zh: 光打在身上，我的刀都拿不稳了。
lines.en: Light hits me and I can't keep hold of my blade.
Two days without food and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷劈在刀尖上，我整条胳膊麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my blade tip and my whole arm goes dead.

lines.zh: 脚下没地，我连刀都抓不住。
lines.en: No ground below; I can't even hold my blade.
